periods.time: Post-war guard service and graduation trip
periods.label: Leader-like member of the Three Harmonies

status.role: becomes one of Lux's official guards

periods.summary: The poised senior of the Three Harmonies. She argues that Lux still needs guards despite peace, helps formalize the group as his royal guard, and hides affection beneath professionalism and teasing.

lux-arcadia.summary: Wants to remain near him as guard even if she cannot be one of his queens.

key_events.summary: Joins Lux, Teifa and Nokotte on the Rairel Town graduation trip and later tends to Lux after he faints in the bath.
Participates in the Hounds suppression and helps capture remaining enemies.
